draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.61, the 240th-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 35th of 37 at CB. He went 244th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 1 interceptions in 2021, 19th of 36 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2023. 20 career games and 3 starts over 2 completed seasons. Career-best season: 2 AV in 2022. Weak spots: approximate value 0 (2nd percentile). Played 6 of 17 games in 2023.
